# pgpeek

> Minimal read-only Postgres browser for support teams. Single Go binary with embedded Preact UI, pgx-backed Postgres access, and a small SQLite saved-query store.

## Canonical docs

- README: https://github.com/descope-sample-apps/pgpeek/blob/main/README.md
- Website: https://descope-sample-apps.github.io/pgpeek/
- Test matrix: https://github.com/descope-sample-apps/pgpeek/blob/main/docs/test-matrix.md
- Source: https://github.com/descope-sample-apps/pgpeek

## Core behavior

- Read-only by design: use a no-write DB role, set `default_transaction_read_only=on`, and reject non-read SQL with `internal/guard`.
- Browse tables/views with paging, row cap, global search, per-column filters, click-to-sort, foreign-key navigation, and CSV export.
- Wide tables stay usable via sticky headers, clipped previews, full-cell reveal, and mobile overflow containment.
- SQL tab supports read-only `SELECT`/`WITH`/`VALUES`/`TABLE`/`EXPLAIN`, CodeMirror autocomplete, saved/preset queries, CSV export, and inline errors.
- Multiple databases/clusters are configured by env lists, numbered env vars, or mounted JSON; selected DB is stored in `?db=`.
- RDS/Aurora IAM auth is supported with `PGPEEK_DB_IAM_AUTH=true` and `PGPEEK_AWS_REGION`.
- Cloudflare Access headers are detected from `Cf-Access-Authenticated-User-Email`; `PGPEEK_REQUIRE_CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS=true` rejects requests missing those headers. This does not validate JWTs.
- Builds and runtime use Go FIPS mode: `GOFIPS140=v1.0.0`, `GODEBUG=fips140=on`.
- Kubernetes security baseline: use a read-only DB role, require database TLS, keep DSNs/passwords in Secrets or external-secret sync, keep non-secret database names/IDs in ConfigMaps, run behind SSO/private access, and never expose pgpeek directly.
- Kubernetes secret options: `DATABASE_URL` from Secret env, `DATABASE_URL_FILE` from a mounted Secret file, `PGPEEK_DATABASE_URLS` from Secret env for multi-DB lists, numbered `PGPEEK_DATABASE_URL_N_FILE` Secret files, `PGPEEK_DATABASES_FILE` ConfigMap JSON with Secret-backed `urlFile` entries, or RDS/Aurora IAM auth via IRSA with no static DB password.

## Important env vars

- `DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_URL_FILE`
- `PGPEEK_DATABASE_URLS`, `PGPEEK_DATABASE_IDS`, `PGPEEK_DATABASE_NAMES`
- `PGPEEK_DATABASE_URL_1`, `PGPEEK_DATABASE_ID_1`, `PGPEEK_DATABASE_NAME_1` and numbered siblings
- `PGPEEK_DATABASES_FILE`, `PGPEEK_DEFAULT_DATABASE`
- `PGPEEK_ROW_CAP`, `PGPEEK_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT`, `PGPEEK_MAX_CONNS`
- `PGPEEK_STORE_PATH`
- `PGPEEK_DB_IAM_AUTH`, `PGPEEK_AWS_REGION`
- `PGPEEK_REQUIRE_CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS`

## HTTP API

- `GET /api/databases` lists configured DBs.
- `GET /api/user` returns `anonymous` or the detected Cloudflare Access email.
- `POST /api/query?db=<id>` runs a read query and returns JSON.
- `POST /api/export?db=<id>` exports query CSV.
- `GET /api/meta?db=<id>` returns UI limits.
- `GET /api/tables?db=<id>` lists tables/views.
- `GET /api/tables/{schema}/{table}/columns?db=<id>` returns structure.
- `GET /api/tables/{schema}/{table}/fks?db=<id>` returns single-column FK refs.
- `GET /api/tables/{schema}/{table}/data?db=<id>&limit=&offset=&search=&sort=&dir=&f=col:op:val` returns paged rows; add `format=csv` for CSV.
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/queries` manages saved queries.
- `GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz` expose probes.

## Build/test commands

- `make build`
- `make image`
- `make test`
- `make test-integration`
- `make cover-check`
- `make lint`
- `make vulncheck`
- `make web-test`
- `make ci`
